measure: The analysis pipeline, wired by hand: RepositoryValidator, the selected roots in MAIN, GENERATED, TEST order, a fresh cache, one RUNNING analysis, then SpoonModelBuilder.analyze with a StructureExtractor over an ElementWriter; every row is read back from code_element, dependency, dependency_evidence, module_dependency, source_file and source_root after end(), edges are DependencyAggregator.aggregate over the rows read back, and the writes are observed by a StructureSink that wraps the ElementWriter and reads each table's max(id) after every accept. A second, untimed pass over the same batches times the two per-unit functions and counts the excluded constructs

selections.DEFAULT: MAIN and GENERATED, no TEST: the analysis default and spoon-corpus.json's population

environment.storage: APPLE SSD AP1024Z internal NVMe SSD
environment.runtime: full JDK under Maven Surefire, not the jlink image the application ships
